title: Tally Playbook: Why does Tally keep failing?
caption:
Why does Tally keep failing?

The exact stack behind this:
1️⃣ One question per line — A form that reads like a conversation, not a corporate survey with 14 boxed fields.
2️⃣ Skip irrelevant questions — Branching shows only what fits the answer — fewer questions, measurably more completions.
3️⃣ Embed or DM — Drop it on your site or send the link straight into an Instagram DM after a comment.
4️⃣ Auto-sync every answer — Submissions land in Notion or a sheet — no CSV exports, no copy-paste, no lost leads.

What would you add? Comment your pick.
